progress.message: Claude Code is designing the animation (revision)

request: Bowler Brawler: Ex-professional goblin bowler. Cocky, plays to the crowd, loves his ball. He holds a bowling ball in his right hand (held out in front of him); keep held items in the same hand. These are his own signature moves: give him a distinct personality, different from other goblins. Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

animations.name: OH_Idle
animations.description: Spins the bowling ball on one raised finger like a basketball for a moment, then catches it and holds it in front of him again, looking smug. Loops.

animations.name: OH_Walk
animations.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: confident strut, ball cradled at his hip.
